messages:
emily_sales: Quick ask from prospect: they want a one-page artifact checklist to sign POC acceptance + clarity on whether we can share the full pen-test report. Deadline: EOD Fri. Also asked if dedicated pricing must be locked before POC.

raj_ps: Minimal artifacts we provide for POC signoff: SOC 2 Type II attestation (or signed controls summary), pen-test attestation letter (signed) or redacted exec summary, staging/UAT network diagram, SSO/SAML integration notes + test account, staging IP whitelist or VPN details, data residency statement, and a short POC runbook (support hours + escalation).

raj_ps: Dedicated/reserved pricing is optional for POC. We can run on shared infra for trial. If they need guaranteed latency we quote a short reserved window (separate addendum).

maria_security: Pen-test sharing policy: default is signed attestation + redacted findings summary. Full/raw report requires an NDA, legal approval, and limited dataroom access. We will not share raw scanner logs or vendor PII.

maria_security: Our attestation template includes scope, date, summary of critical/high findings, and remediation commitments. We can sign a technical attestation; legal should sign contractual addenda. If customer insists on full report, ask for CISO/legal contact and reason for full disclosure.

tom_ops: Staging IPs for quick POC: we offer ephemeral CIDR blocks for 2-week windows (example: 34.100.200.0/28 ingress, 34.100.200.16/30 callbacks). Static public IPs are available but need ~72 hours lead time and may change billing if reserved infra is required.

tom_ops: Example firewall snippet they can paste:
- UAT ingress: 34.100.200.0/28
- Callbacks: 34.100.200.16/30
- Admin API: 34.100.200.42

emily_sales: Can we turn this into a single checklist I can email to the buyer? They specifically asked: "network diagram + SSO + pen-test letter = enough for signoff?"

raj_ps: Usually yes. Proposed one-page acceptance checklist to send:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation OR signed controls summary
- Pen-test attestation letter OR redacted exec summary (statement of no open criticals)
- Network architecture diagram covering staging/UAT and any on-prem connectors
- SSO/SAML test user validated in staging
- Confirmation of staging IP whitelist or VPN details
- POC support hours + escalation contact
- If required: KMS/key custody statement or HSM integration note

raj_ps: Note: any high findings must include remediation ETA. Low/medium findings ok if documented with plan.

maria_security: I'll attach the pen-test attestation template and can redline if their legal provides changes. If they ask for full report, we'll require NDA + dataroom contact.

emily_sales: Thanks — I'll send the checklist and ask whether they want redacted summary vs full report. I'll capture their legal/CISO and loop you in if they push for full disclosure or static IPs.

tom_ops: Ping me for the ops ticket if they request static IPs or a month-long reserved window.

emily_sales: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
